findings.summary: If every pool member's load_weights fails, ladder silently logs 0 games and promotion stalls forever with no error signal.

promote() swaps champion_store Arc to the same challenger ChannelEvaluator on the live-training tx; champion_backend_handle is never load_weights'd. Combined with the pool filter that excludes current champion_version, after first promotion pool goes empty → bootstrap → champion == challenger → self-play noise. Only escapes with ≥2 archives, but filter blocks getting there.
Two eval tests use ..EvaluationConfig::default() so checkpoints_dir='checkpoints' relative; developers running cargo test after a real training run will fail assert_eq!(store_ref.version(), 5).
PGN game numbering restarts per opponent inside the pool loop, producing duplicate 'Eval Cycle N Game K' labels within a cycle.
All 5 new HYZERO_* env parses use .ok().and_then(parse).ok().unwrap_or(default); malformed values silently revert to defaults with no warning line.
run_baseline.sh awk formula hard-codes '- 1500.0'; operator override of HYZERO_OPPONENT_INITIAL_ELO desyncs baseline composite from runtime gate.
LAST_CANDIDATE_ELO fallback string is dead code; a NaN/inf candidate_elo would silently coerce to 0 in awk, dropping SCORE by ~75.
total_games_since_last_promotion not incremented in 'opp handle unset' continue branch (346-376), so cooldown fires later than intended when opponent setup skips.

notes: Later commits on sibling branches (b1a4065 'keep champion batcher alive across promotion', 99c73fa 'surface POOL_DEAD') appear to fix findings #1 and #2 — worth checking if they have landed to main or are still stranded.
No todo!/unimplemented! in mainline paths. No mutex-across-await. Elo math and pool enumeration verified arithmetically sound.
Open question: is pool_size=0 a supported operator knob or an error? Currently silently → bootstrap forever.
